prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve targeted portrait correction.
Image 1 is the v1 HEAD PORTRAIT EDIT TARGET, NOT a full-body picture. Images 2-5 are pixel STYLE only. Keep THIS person and the same head angle; do not copy another reference face or worried expression.
Keep a vertical 74:100 whole canvas and genuine transparent background. Preserve the full hairstyle and ears inside a tiny transparent margin. Maintain the broad hard-edged cheekbone, nose and jaw pixel clusters and muted earth colors designed for <=32 colors. Merge distracting thin isolated hair/beard strokes into fewer larger connected locks, no new fine texture. No anti-aliasing, gradients, noisy stipple or smooth paint. No props, text, labels, frame, body, limbs, hands, legs or narrative event.
This is the only corrective revision: a substantive imagegen edit with later disclosed NN resize and palette quantization, not native pixel authorship.
Keep YANI exactly as a male retired soldier in his thirties with dark chestnut hair, short gray-brown beard, lean mature face, prominent wedge nose and faded olive / gray-brown old jacket palette. Do not age him into an old man or change sex or identity.
Correct the expression precisely: lower BOTH inner ends of eyebrows to a relaxed almost horizontal line, with slight natural asymmetry. Remove the worried upward inner eyebrow arches and the alarmed central forehead crease. Heavy tired half-lowered upper eyelids, smaller horizontally narrow eyes. Dark iris looking calmly to viewer right; eye white is only a tiny muted tan-gray sliver, never an ivory or white block. His expression must be dry, weary and autonomous, quietly unimpressed, not sorrowful, scared, helpless or angry.
Close his mouth fully into ONE short firm dark horizontal/slightly asymmetrical line. No mouth opening, black mouth hole, exposed teeth, parted lips or pout.
Make the healed old chin scar one tiny connected skin-toned notch interrupting the lower beard edge, distinct from gray hair, no bright white stripe and no red/fresh wound. Keep it modest.
Enlarge the face/head occupancy a little while shortening exposed neck; head/hair/beard occupy about 90% height. Only a narrow gray-brown collar and olive clothing strip at bottom 7%, not shoulder width or chest. Avoid clipping the hair/ears. No medals, standing posture or suggestion of recovery; brace and intact leg are outside this head-only frame.

Mandatory edge safety correction: retain a transparent margin equivalent to 2 logical pixels at LEFT and RIGHT and 2 logical pixels at TOP and BOTTOM of the eventual 74x100 canvas. No opaque hair or clothing touches the actual image borders. Keep head large by reducing neck/clothing rather than shrinking the face; every hair tip and ear must remain whole.
